quote: The Orsay notes contained 'a humble statement that would soon become the most important question about the Mandelbrot set: the MLC conjecture.' Part I of the Orsay Notes was published as Orsay 84-02 in 1984.
posed_by: Adrien Douady and John H. Hubbard
note: The conjecture was formulated in the Orsay Notes (Etude dynamique des polynômes complexes) based on Douady's lectures during the 1983-1984 academic year. The underlying work dates to 1981-1982, but Part I of the published Orsay Notes (where the conjecture appears) was issued in 1984.
